description: Regular contact with the Alpha Quadrant begins changing life aboard Voyager while Borg survivors, alien societies and the Doctor's expanding personhood force the crew to reconsider what homecoming will mean.

s06e01.description: Janeway pursues Captain Ransom with escalating fury as the Equinox crew continues exploiting alien life-forms for propulsion.

s06e02.description: Three former Borg from Seven's unimatrix seek her help breaking a psychic link created during an earlier crash.

s06e03.description: After a near-death experience, B'Elanna believes her mother is condemned to Klingon hell and risks her life to save her.

s06e04.description: The Doctor's new daydreaming subroutine is mistaken by observing aliens for reality, giving them a wildly inflated view of his authority.

s06e05.description: Paris restores an alien shuttle whose neurogenic interface becomes possessive, gradually isolating him from Voyager and taking control of his behavior.

s06e06.description: An attack damages Tuvok's mind, leaving him emotionally open and dependent on Neelix while the crew searches for his invisible assailant.

s06e07.description: Voyager awakens soldiers from centuries of stasis and becomes entangled in the old war that put them there.

s06e08.description: Voyager investigates a subspace anomaly containing the remains of an early human Mars mission, turning a rescue operation into archaeological recovery.

s06e09.description: Seven absorbs too much of Voyager's database and constructs increasingly elaborate theories that Janeway and Chakotay secretly engineered the ship's fate.

s06e10.description: On Earth, Barclay's obsession with Voyager simulations becomes the unlikely basis for Starfleet's first successful real-time contact with the lost ship.

s06e11.description: The crew relaxes in Paris's holographic Irish village while Janeway becomes emotionally involved with one of its characters.

s06e12.description: Voyager becomes trapped above a planet where centuries pass below during days aboard ship, shaping an entire civilization's view of the starship.

s06e13.description: Aliens with no musical tradition idolize the Doctor's singing, tempting him to abandon Voyager for celebrity and artistic recognition.

s06e14.description: Four crewmen experience traumatic memories of a massacre they never committed and trace them to a monument designed to prevent historical forgetting.

s06e15.description: Seven and Tuvok are kidnapped during shore leave, forcing Seven into a brutal televised combat sport.

s06e16.description: Voyager encounters a damaged Borg cube controlled by frightened children who were left behind after their maturation chambers opened early.

s06e17.description: Long-running Fair Haven characters become aware of strange events and interpret Voyager's interventions as supernatural threats.

s06e18.description: A crewmate believed dead returns physically transformed after an alien species resurrected her and raised her as one of their own.

s06e19.description: Voyager finds Icheb's parents, but Seven suspects their eagerness to reclaim him hides the reason he was assimilated in the first place.

s06e20.description: Janeway takes three struggling crew members on a small mission and discovers how far they have drifted from life aboard Voyager.

s06e21.description: Con artists impersonating Janeway, Tuvok and Chakotay damage Voyager's reputation while profiting from fake Federation diplomacy.

s06e22.description: B'Elanna becomes the secret inspiration for a playwright on a preindustrial world whose drama mirrors Voyager's missing crew.

s06e23.description: An aged Kes returns with destructive powers and attempts to alter her own history by delivering Voyager to the Vidiians years earlier.

s06e24.description: The Doctor is sent to the Alpha Quadrant to treat his dying creator, Lewis Zimmerman, who resents the obsolete hologram modeled on himself.

s06e25.description: During a shipwide power shutdown, Neelix tells the Borg children a ghost story that may actually describe an alien presence aboard Voyager.

s06e26.description: Seven discovers a hidden dream world where some Borg drones experience individuality, and Janeway plans a dangerous intervention inside the Collective.
